about: Offline flow replay suite (tools/genra/replay_flow.py). Each case is a full run made on approved keys: its brief.json carries the approved keys (keys/result.json) and the rig pack, scratch/result.json is the take that was made. accepted is the owner-accepted take on the same keys where one exists. game_ticks is the length the game plays the clip in, with where that number comes from. guard cases check behaviour (a loop seam, planted feet), not flow quality.
